title: Generalize DAG Nodes to Input and Output Kinds
description: Generalize DAG nodes from single IoNodeSpec to tagged kinds (Computation, Slider, Select, Screen) with per-kind rendering, local widget interaction, and React DOM media overlays for Screen nodes.
summary: Generalized DAG nodes from uniform IoNodeSpec rectangles to tagged DagNodeSpec kinds (computation, slider, select, screen) with per-kind Vello rendering, local slider/select interaction (no propagation), and React DOM media overlays for screen nodes via DagSession.nodeOverlaysJson(). Updated demo fixture (5 nodes / 4 edges), Flow DagNodeSpec::computation mapping, tests, and runtime validator.
